subtasks: Arrange the five nesting dolls in a row from left to right, from smallest to largest.
Move the second-largest doll, now on the far left, into the gap between the middle-sized doll and the largest doll on the right. Keep it upright.

Use the right gripper to place the upright second-largest doll at the front center into the empty row position between the middle doll and the largest doll on the right. Return both open arms to their starting poses.
